packageRules.description: A new ps-server/ps-client tag is a release, not a dependency bump: it needs a release-snapshot entry and possibly a capability-registry entry (documentation/39-release-procedure.md), and not every pushed tag is a release (ps-server:3.29 is a CI-verification build that Renovate proposed in PR #12). Digest updates for the same tag stay enabled - tags are never moved, so one would be an incident worth seeing.

Confirmed live 2026-09-23: Renovate proposed 1.31.6 as an update to the pinned 1.30.5, but 1.31.x is nginx's mainline release line, not a newer stable one (nginx:stable still resolved to 1.30.5 at the same time). Renovate has no notion of this split - it only sees version numbers - so this pins it to the 1.30.x line until a human deliberately updates this regex, which should happen only after confirming nginx:stable has actually moved (see release/approved-digests.json's nginx entry for how to check).
